seed: With the grid on, a ring says where a press would put the first point. On a plain screenshot with no grid the same tools still pull that first point onto a border they found in the picture, and until now you only found out after you pressed. This walks a real capture with no grid on at all.

steps.note: a real 1440x960 screenshot opened at half zoom, grid off, Snap to grid never touched: the only lines here are the ones the app found in the picture
out in the flat middle of the pane with no border within reach: a press lands under the pointer, so nothing is drawn. This is the half that keeps the ring from riding the cursor saying nothing
the pointer is at 104,560 and the ring is at 105,572: a border found in the picture has the first point, twelve points from the hand, and you can see that before you press instead of after
Command means exactly where the pointer is, here as everywhere else on this canvas, so there is no ring claiming otherwise
near a corner of the picture's own structure both axes catch, and the ring sits on the crossing at 110,504 rather than on either line alone
the same ring on the same border under the arrow tool: aiming is one rule across the drawing tools rather than one tool's feature
and under the line tool: rectangle, arrow and line all read the same answer off the same snap
a box dragged out from the very point the ring was last read at: its corner landed on 105,572, exactly where the ring said it would. The ring and the press ask the same question of the same code
